:::{#exr-log-partition-second-derivative}
#### The second derivative of the log-partition function is the variance of the statistic

In the setting of @exr-log-partition-derivative,
differentiate both sides of

$$
\dif{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam}
= \int \statf{\rvar} \, \pdf\paren{\rvar ; \natparam} \, d\rvar
$$

with respect to $\natparam$.
Assume that the [derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-derivative) of the
[integral](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures-integrals.html#def-integral)
is the integral of the derivative.
Use @thm-log-partition-mean
and the [second moment](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#lem-second-moment-variance)
to show that

$$
\dif{^2 \logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam^2} = \Var{\statf{\Rvar}}.
$$

:::
